Hello Mastodon! 👋 #Introduction

I build free, fast, and 100% client-side web utilities that run locally in your browser—zero server uploads, no sign-ups, and full respect for your privacy. 🔒

My first release is Smart CSV Sanitizer: deduplicate rows, format phone numbers, mask PII & export clean Excel/CSV with UTF-8 BOM.

Try it free: https://smart-csv-sanitizer.vercel.app/

#WebDev #OpenWeb #Privacy #Productivity
